title: KCP lens_create request (DESIGN.md §10.2, §11.6.1 space/content mutation family)
description: Mutation (meta required; §11.2: every state-changing operation requires meta). Creates a SpaceLens (§10.2): a declarative, schema-bounded presentation over authorized canonical records in one space, containing no arbitrary code (§10.2). lens_id, owner_ref, revision, and status are server-derived (gap note KG5). Registry (shared_space_v1): surface external_client / principal (assurance: current login). Surface and actor kind are registry-enforced, not schema-expressible (gap note KG14 for dual-surface ops).

query_ast.description: Closed query AST over indexed fields and bounded relation traversal (§10.2); grammar unpinned in this slice — open object carrying no authority (gap note KG25).

sort_spec.description: Lens sort specification (§10.2 names the field); shape unpinned (gap note KG25).

presentation_options.description: Lens presentation configuration (§10.2 names the field); shape unpinned (gap note KG25).

visibility.description: Lens visibility token; §10.2 names the field with no value space (gap notes KG6/KG25).

args.description: Caller-suppliable SpaceLens fields (§10.2 record shape, names verbatim; gap note KG25).

commandMeta.description: Command.meta (§11.2). Required on every mutation; idempotency keys are scoped by authenticated actor, operation, and realm; expected_revision drives optimistic concurrency (mismatch is stale-revision).

ext.description: Extensions keyed by a reverse-domain namespace (§11.9); never interpreted as identity, authorization, budget, or policy.

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

lensKind.description: Closed SpaceLens.kind enum, verbatim §10.2 (§11.8: closed); Stream is a lens preset, not a second content model (§10.4).

protocolVersion.description: Negotiated KCP major.minor version; the initial protocol version is "0.1" (§11).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§11.8 rejects unsafe integers).

statusToken.description: Bounded lowercase token for a field DESIGN.md names without pinning a value space; pins the shape without inventing an enum (gap note KG6).

traceparent.description: W3C Trace Context traceparent header value; excluded from the idempotency request digest (§11.2).
